newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Nanjing Posts sees surge in H1 net.
newsitem.headline: China's Nanjing Posts sees surge in H1 net.

text.p: China's Nanjing Posts & Telecommunications Equipment Co Ltd recorded unaudited net profits of 30 million yuan in the first half of 1997, a company official said on Tuesday.
The figure compared with audited net profits of 18.45 million yuan for the same period a year ago, he said.

Sales reached 215 million yuan in January-June against 153 million yuan the same period last year, an official at the firm's financing department told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
The results were compiled under international accounting standards, the official said.
The surge in first-half earnings was due to healthy sales of new products, including multi-media computers, he said but declined to elaborate.

The company, which listed 100 million B shares in Shenzhen in May this year, has forecast after-tax profits of 51 million yuan on sales of 390 million yuan for the whole of 1996 under international standards, the official said.

The firm, based in Nanjing, capital of eastern Jiangsu province, posted net profits of 45.63 million yuan on sales of 331.46 million yuan for the first ten months of last year based on international standards.
Audited results for 1996 would be released along with the company's forthcoming 1997 interim results, the official said.
